detailed_descriptions.en: An incremental archery game filled with tons of content. Unlock new mechanics while clearing waves of target-like monsters. Massive Skill Tree: No wasted points, just real upgrades that feel good to unlock. Jobs System: Unlock 5 Archer jobs and become the most powerful archer in Zad. Loot: Each target enemy drops unique rare loot that significantly improves your character. Skills : Acquire and upgrade a variety of skills to eliminate your foes. Crafting: A deep crafting system that allows you to create powerful bows and armor. Mining: Master mining to vastly empower your archer skills and completely transform them. And TONS of content: Shaping , Masteries , Guardian Perks and MORE.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
An incremental archery game filled with tons of content. Unlock new mechanics while clearing waves of target-like monsters.

  • Massive Skill Tree: No wasted points, just real upgrades that feel good to unlock.

  • Jobs System: Unlock 5 Archer jobs and become the most powerful archer in Zad.

  • Loot: Each target enemy drops unique rare loot that significantly improves your character.

  • Skills: Acquire and upgrade a variety of skills to eliminate your foes.

  • Crafting: A deep crafting system that allows you to create powerful bows and armor.

  • Mining: Master mining to vastly empower your archer skills and completely transform them.

  • And TONS of content: Shaping, Masteries, Guardian Perks and MORE.
